newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Intl acquires Energy Reclaim.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Intl acquires Energy Reclaim.

text.p: Lone Star International Energy Inc said on Thursday it has acquired Energy Reclaim Refrigeration Inc for $10 million of restricted shares of Lone Star common stock.

Energy Reclaim has developed and holds patents on an absorption refrigeration technology which has applications for the commercial fishing, maritime, utility and oil & gas industries, the company said.
Calvin Cline, sole stockholder of Energy Reclaim, has entered into an employment services contract with Lone Star, Lone Star said.
Also, Lone Star said it is in discussions with a major utility regarding further development of the technology's application.
